An '''unidentified Cyblocian assassin''' from the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian Sector]] was an [[Prisoner/Legends|inmate]] at the [[Cog Hive Seven]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]]. Wanting to celebrate his [[Birthday/Legends|birthday]] in style, the [[Cyblocian]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] payed an inmate named [[Dakarai Blirr|Zero]] to [[Smuggler|smuggle]] [[Spiced Mynock Wing|spiced mynock wings]] into the prison.
